description: Explicitly authored offline model evidence for the unchanged 22-step storage_interruption fixture. Geometry, timing, trajectories, parked poses, helper outputs, process ledger completeness and excluded-resource envelopes are synthetic assumptions, not measured execution or physical feasibility.

source_scene.declaration: Resource identities come from the referenced scene. resource_type values in applicability are reviewed manifest classifications for this offline fixture.

modeling_assumptions: Every KMR primitive occupies one second on the shared horizon [0, 22]. Motion evidence is piecewise linear through the supplied endpoints and bound waypoints, with fixed orientation and base yaw.
geometry.resources footprints are synthetic world-axis-aligned envelopes; KMR has separate modeled arm/tool and base envelopes. These envelopes do not establish CAD or forward-kinematics enclosure.

ur5e-1, ur5e-2, ur5e-3 and ur5e-4 are explicitly stationary outside assembly_board-v1 in this baseline. Their synthetic current_pose coordinates reuse scene base_xyz values, not observed TCP poses. Tests may supply concurrent trajectories.

Both parts have immutable, explicitly complete synthetic processCompleted ledgers for this horizon. The trim result for KET4_Square_4mm predates the initial checkpoint; none of these 22 primitives creates a process completion.
KET4_Square_4mm starts outside the bound region. This fresh offline trace does not certify events before the checkpoint.
The released KET8_Square_8mm remains stationary in Storage from t=3 through reacquisition at t=20. KET4_Square_4mm is stationary through its first grasp at t=9 and after release at t=13 through t=22.

The seven excluded nonrobot resources have explicitly synthetic, stationary outside bounds centred on their scene world_pose coordinates; these bounds are reviewed fixture assumptions, not physical dimensions.
